map.title: MAP 1 · MONUMENT
map.intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. Your colleague learns from every crash; keep finding new ways. Certification awaits.

tiles.title: The welcome wall
tiles.newIdea: Controls: walk into the red car's path.
tiles.tale: Fresh off the factory floor. Your colleague drives straight through today. Step into its path and make engineers proud.
tiles.hint: Walk into the red car's lane as it arrives.

tiles.title: The podium bridge
tiles.newIdea: The car learns once: it brakes for a dummy in its lane.
tiles.tale: Battery 1 is fitted. After one crash, your colleague brakes for dummies in its lane. Dash in from the side.
tiles.hint: Once it brakes, wait beside the road and dash in.

tiles.title: The LED drum
tiles.newIdea: Side sensors: it notices a dummy waiting beside the road.
tiles.tale: The LED drum lights each bend. Your colleague now watches the kerb; step down from the plinth instead.
tiles.hint: Climb the plinth; drop or jump onto the car.

tiles.title: The portal tower
tiles.newIdea: Roof lidar: the raised plinth no longer hides you.
tiles.tale: The road runs through the portal tower. Roof lidar is installed; the plinth is visible. Spring from cover.
tiles.hint: Hide behind cover, then jump into the car.

tiles.title: The monument
tiles.newIdea: Street cameras: cover no longer hides you from the car.
tiles.tale: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS: a target, not a record. Cameras now watch cover. Hands 1: bait with cones.
tiles.hint: Drop a cone in its lane; strike while it swerves.

tiles.title: The neon shops
tiles.newIdea: DUCK: hide behind low planters once cones stop working.
tiles.tale: The neon shops sell nothing. Your colleague now stops for cones, so duck behind the planters and wait.
tiles.hint: Duck behind a planter; spring out as it passes.

tiles.title: The stacked cubes
tiles.newIdea: Crash memory: it watches every spot where it hit you.
tiles.tale: The stacked cubes rose one budget at a time. Your colleague remembers every crash spot. Never repeat yourself.
tiles.hint: Take each hit somewhere new; it watches old spots.

tiles.title: The LED canyon
tiles.newIdea: The search: lose its sight and it hunts your last spot.
tiles.tale: Two screens advertise to each other all night. Seen, then hidden, you will be searched for. Crawl away.
tiles.hint: Stay out of sight cones; crawl clear of its search.

tiles.title: The LED gateway
tiles.newIdea: Two-way traffic: white cars that never learn give moving cover.
tiles.tale: The gateway thanks every car for driving safely. White colleagues never learn; use them as moving cover. Certification awaits.
tiles.hint: Walk behind a white car; strike the red one.

rationale: Each tile moves one rung up: 10.1 to 10.9, nine stages, no repeats. Each tile adds one sensor or tool. Most objectives ask for two hits, so the player beats the car before and after it learns. Counts follow measured open ways: two hits on the narrow 10.5 and 10.6 tiles, three on 10.7 (roaming 6.97 a minute), four on the open 10.9 payoff. 10.10 stays out because the search must come before rung-7 traffic.
